issue.title: [Bug] Cant manually set up primary source
issue.body:
### What went wrong?

First, I uploaded an EPUB file, then I added some MP3 files. After that, I deleted the original EPUB, which automatically set the MP3s as the primary source. But once I uploaded a new EPUB file, I couldn't figure out how to switch the primary source back to it.

### Steps to reproduce

Upload an EPUB file to the project/entry.

Upload one or more MP3 files to the same entry.

Delete the original EPUB file. (Note: The MP3 file is automatically set as the primary source).

Upload a new EPUB file.

Attempt to change the primary source back to the newly uploaded EPUB file

### Expected vs actual behavior

There should be an option or setting to select and set the new EPUB file as the primary source.

### Your setup

- latest bookorbit
- synology docker

issue.title: [Bug] Audiobook progress updates (e.g. from Morrow) do not trigger automatic Hardcover sync
issue.body:
### What went wrong?

Progress from the Morrow iOS app is correctly saved in BookOrbit for audiobooks, but it is never pushed to Hardcover automatically. Manual “Sync Now” works and sends the correct progress.

Suggested fix

Hook HardcoverSyncService.sync_progress / sync_book into the successful audio-progress update path (mirroring the existing hooks for sessions and Kobo state).

### Steps to reproduce

Play an audiobook directly on bookorbit or via a client. Reading progress is moving but it's not automatically synced with Hardcover.

### Expected vs actual behavior

Expected behavior

When audiobook progress is updated (via PATCH /api/v1/books/{id}/audio-progress or equivalent), BookOrbit should automatically call HardcoverSyncService the same way it does for:

Kobo state updates (PUT /api/v1/kobo/.../state)
Reading session creation (POST /api/v1/books/files/.../sessions)
Book status changes (PATCH /api/v1/books/.../status)

Actual behavior

Progress is stored and visible in BookOrbit (matches what Morrow shows).
No hardcover.sync_progress / hardcover.sync_book log entries are produced by audio-progress updates.
Only a manual POST /api/v1/hardcover/books/{id}/sync (or bulk sync) pushes the progress to Hardcover.

Evidence from logs (bookId=331, audiobook)

Repeated successful manual syncs show increasing progressSeconds (e.g. 10169 → 22650 → 27837 → 39342), confirming progress is stored.
Automatic Hardcover sync only appears for Kobo/session/status paths, never for audio-progress.
Many PATCH /api/v1/books/331/audio-progress requests return 401 (possible secondary auth issue on one client), but even successful progress writes do not trigger Hardcover.

### Your setup

Environment

BookOrbit v2.8.1
Audiobook format: m4b
Client writing progress: Morrow (iOS)
Hardcover integration enabled and working for manual sync + ebook/Kobo paths



### Relevant logs (optional)

```shell

```

### Screenshots (optional)

_No response_
